_README: Copy to configs/events.json and fill in REAL dates before relying on
the event gates. This template ships EMPTY on purpose: fabricated FOMC
or CPI dates would silently blacklist the wrong days and clear the
right ones, which is worse than having no calendar at all.
Primary sources (refresh once a year, both publish ~12 months ahead):
NFP is NOT listed here: options_trader/risk/events.py derives it as the
first Friday of each month. Add an explicit NFP entry only to override
a month BLS shifted for a federal holiday — an explicit entry wins over
the derived one for the same (date, kind).
kind: one of FOMC, CPI, NFP, EARNINGS (see events.MAJOR_KINDS).
Single-name earnings come from the MCP get_earnings_calendar call at
scan time, not from this file.
